title: Judge work support before prose
summary: For each accomplishment Jev evaluates work relevance, exact requirement support, specificity, duplication and functional tool placement using actual evidence.
body: For each accomplishment Jev evaluates work relevance, exact requirement support, specificity, duplication and functional tool placement using actual evidence. Support choices are Direct, Partial, Adjacent, No support and Uncertain. Selection precedes prose generation.
